reference.host: AWS c8g.xlarge Graviton4, Ubuntu 24.04, kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws, gcc 13.3.0
reference.command: ffmpeg -f <ac3|eac3|aac|dts> -i pipe:0 -vn -ac 2 -f pulse|alsa  (both muxers default to pcm_s16le)

matrix.source: the resampler's own reported matrix for every multichannel vector (native debug log)

rules.lfe: LFE to both at lfe_level / sqrt(2)
rules.back centre: BC to both at surround_level / sqrt(2)
rules.surround pairs, Dolby (Lt/Rt): every surround: -surround_level/sqrt(2) to L, +surround_level/sqrt(2) to R
rules.surround pairs, Pro Logic II: left surround: -sqrt(3/2)*s to L, +sqrt(1/2)*s to R; right surround: -sqrt(1/2)*s to L, +sqrt(3/2)*s to R
rules.normalisation: each output row divided by its absolute coefficient sum when that sum exceeds 1 (s16 output)

matrix.levels: AC-3/E-AC-3 downmix side data (Lo/Ro levels unless the stream prefers Lt/Rt, which selects Lt/Rt levels and Dolby, or Pro Logic II encoding); other codecs: center 1/sqrt(2), surround 1/sqrt(2), lfe 0

observed.monsters_inc_5.1_448_small.ac3: center 0.707107 surround 0.5 lfe 0: FL .453082 FC .320377 SL .226541

sample_conversion.evidence: best fit on all 12 observed vectors: mismatch fraction 1e-6 .. 1.3e-3, never more than 1 LSB (round-to-nearest mismatches ~50%)

rate: decoder output rate, unchanged (no resampling in the device path; the sound server resamples)
open: Dolby (Lt/Rt) is observed on one vector only; dual mono and 2/3-block E-AC-3 untested
AAC PCE matrix-mixdown metadata is not exported by FFmpeg's decoder as downmix side data (defaults apply)
